# Porting checklist

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/engine_audit.py --write-porting — do not edit.
     Rule OS-01 fails when this file is out of date. -->

What a new OS must implement before the engine builds on it. Every line is
an `#error "port: …"` in the source, so an unlisted OS fails to compile
with this list instead of compiling and misbehaving. Windows, macOS and
Linux implement all of it. An OS that really is POSIX-family is one line in
`src/core/os_family.h`.

**15 item(s)**

| file | the port must provide |
|---|---|
| `src/core/frame_arena.h` | FrameArena overflow needs an aligned heap allocation (and its matching free) |
| `src/core/frame_arena.h` | FrameArena overflow needs the free that matches its aligned allocation |
| `src/core/memory/mem.cpp` | core/memory needs a 2 MB-aligned reserve+commit of address space (mapAligned) |
| `src/core/memory/mem.cpp` | core/memory needs a mutex that is trivially destructible and statically initialisable (ImmortalMutex) |
| `src/core/memory/mem.cpp` | core/memory needs page mapping, a page-size query and a trivially destructible mutex |
| `src/core/memory/mem.cpp` | core/memory needs the OS page size |
| `src/core/memory/mem.cpp` | core/memory needs to release what mapAligned mapped (unmapRegion) |
| `src/runtime/module_loader.h` | module loading needs a dynamic loader, or static module registration (WO-025) |
| `src/runtime/module_loader.h` | module loading needs libOpen/libSym/libClose/libError and a process id |
| `src/runtime/platform/glfw_platform.cpp` | GLFW tool windows need native window handle retrieval |
| `src/runtime/platform/glfw_platform.cpp` | the GLFW main window needs native window handle retrieval |
| `src/runtime/platform/sdl3_platform.cpp` | SDL3 tool windows need native window handle retrieval |
| `src/runtime/platform/sdl3_platform.cpp` | the SDL3 main window needs native window handle retrieval |
| `src/runtime/platform/window_ops_glfw.cpp` | window_ops (GLFW) needs native window handle retrieval |
| `src/runtime/platform/window_ops_sdl3.cpp` | window_ops (SDL3) needs native window handle retrieval |
